description: Source code for the 'Company' doctype in ERPNext, defining the Company class with methods for validation, creation, update, and deletion of company data, as well as utility functions related to company management.

classes.name: Company
classes.description: Represents a company in ERPNext with methods for validation, creation, update, and deletion of company data, including handling of accounts, warehouses, and related configurations.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads address and contact information when the company document is loaded.

methods.name: check_if_transactions_exist
methods.description: Checks if there are existing transactions for the company.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks before saving the company document.

methods.name: validate_abbr
methods.description: Validates and sets the company's abbreviation.

methods.name: create_default_tax_template
methods.description: Creates default tax templates for the company.

methods.name: validate_default_accounts
methods.description: Validates default accounts belong to the company and have correct currency.

methods.name: validate_currency
methods.description: Ensures the company's default currency can be changed only if no transactions exist.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles updates after the company document is saved, including creating accounts, warehouses, and fixtures.

methods.name: create_default_warehouses
methods.description: Creates default warehouses for the company.

methods.name: create_default_accounts
methods.description: Creates default chart of accounts for the company.

methods.name: validate_coa_input
methods.description: Validates chart of accounts input based on creation method.

methods.name: validate_perpetual_inventory
methods.description: Validates perpetual inventory settings.

methods.name: validate_perpetual_inventory_for_non_stock_items
methods.description: Validates perpetual inventory for non-stock items.

methods.name: check_country_change
methods.description: Checks if the company's country has changed.

methods.name: set_chart_of_accounts
methods.description: Sets chart of accounts based on parent company if applicable.

methods.name: validate_parent_company
methods.description: Validates that the parent company is a group.

methods.name: set_default_accounts
methods.description: Sets default accounts for the company.

methods.name: _set_default_account
methods.description: Helper to set a default account for a given field.

methods.name: set_mode_of_payment_account
methods.description: Sets default mode of payment account.

methods.name: create_default_cost_center
methods.description: Creates default cost centers for the company.

methods.name: after_rename
methods.description: Handles operations after renaming the company.

methods.name: abbreviate
methods.description: Generates abbreviation from company name.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Deletes associated data when the company is trashed.
